label: Early warning — 25-pod mesh, S-shape FPV drone 10→1 km @ 60 km/h
description: Defensive mesh of 25 BladeRF/SX1262 sensor pods + rear Command-and-Control node, all sharing the same 5-arc layout (1/3/5/7/10 km). 5.8 GHz FPV drone enters from 10.5 km out and weaves in a big S over the approach so the soldier hears km countdown 10→1 PLUS multiple bearing-cue transitions across DEG_330, 360, 030, 060. Sim runs at 10× real (~54 s playback).
